threshold_rule: linear empirical quantiles of pre2010 predictors only; no losses or outcomes used
gap_rule: signed mean strength gap: away_advantage if D<-median(abs(D)); home_advantage if D>median(abs(D)); otherwise relatively_close
uncertainty_measure: sqrt(strength_difference_variance), including covariance and jump variance; model-implied SD, not actual score error

standardization.support: retain only cells with at least one game in every member; report all exclusions and sparse counts, no filling
standardization.weights: pooled evaluation-cohort cell counts in each comparison set, renormalized over common cells; label-free descriptive target
standardization.no_common_support: blank adjusted metrics, explicit unsupported status

africa_calibration: five already-fixed probability bins, separately by signed-gap3 and uncertainty3; no threshold search
inference: descriptive composition analysis only; not causal attribution, validated intervals or proof of information insufficiency
